children: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said on Thursday the government would announce a support package next week aimed at containing heating oil costs ahead of the winter season, with contributions from both the state and domestic refineries.
Speaking to state broadcaster ERT, Mitsotakis said heating oil would go on sale at a price below €1.75 per litre, the level at which the previous season ended.
